reactor.guidance: Share the working batch volume, product and operating conditions.

vessel.guidance: Share the required nominal volume, service fluid and orientation.

thermal.guidance: Share process fluid, inlet and outlet temperatures, and flow rates if known.

column.guidance: Include the feed composition and whether the flow is a mass or volumetric rate.

dryer.guidance: Specify the batch load, whether it is wet or dry, and target moisture if known.

filter.guidance: Share filter area or cake volume if known, plus slurry and cake characteristics.

blender.guidance: Share working volume and the product bulk density if known.
